text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $65k with modest gains, while Ethereum has outpaced it significantly at +4.3%, suggesting some rotational interest toward altcoins despite overall caution. The Fear & Greed index at 30 indicates investors remain risk-averse, though the slight uptick over the week hints at a tentative stabilization. Bitcoin dominance at 56.4% with $53B in daily volume reflects a market in consolidation—enough liquidity to trade but not the conviction or risk appetite for a sustained rally.
